name: Sunken Sunlight Caustics
promptTemplate: Sunlight caustics glowing in {{water_clarity}} water with {{depth_feel}} depth, drifting at {{wave_speed}} speed with {{caustic_sharpness}} focus, {{tile_scale}} tile size, {{refraction_wobble}} wobble, and {{sun_intensity}} sunlight, swimmer ripples {{swimmer_ripples}}, sparkles {{sparkles}}, chromatic fringe {{chromatic_fringe}}.

ui.title: Pool Caustics Studio
ui.tagline: Real-time sunlight refraction over deep pool tiles

wave_speed.hint: Speed of the underwater light web shifting across the tiles

caustic_sharpness.hint: Narrow the caustic ribbons into razor-sharp filaments

tile_scale.hint: Scale of underwater tiles on the floor

refraction_wobble.hint: Bend and warp the ceramic grout grid under the swell

sun_intensity.hint: Glow and beam brightness penetrating the pool floor

swimmer_ripples.hint: Pulse outward shockwaves on musical beats

sparkles.hint: Drifting floating flecks catching direct light

chromatic_fringe.hint: Prismatic colour fringing on sharp caustic edges

listing.blurb: A luminous web of sunlight caustics drifts and refracts over submerged swimming pool tiles, bending to the pulse of water currents.
listing.prompt: Sunlight caustics on the floor of a swimming pool: a shifting web of bright rippling lines over pale blue tiles, the grout lines wobbling with refraction, the pattern drifting with the water. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
